desc: Tata Steel's Jamshedpur plant is the oldest integrated steel plant in India, established in 1907 by Jamsetji Tata. It is located in Jamshedpur, Jharkhand, and has an annual capacity of over 11 million metric tons. The plant was the first steel plant in Asia to receive the ISO 14001 certification for environmental management. It produces a wide range of steel products including flat and long products for automotive, construction, and engineering sectors. The plant is the flagship facility of Tata Steel, which is among the top global steel companies.

desc: Bhilai Steel Plant, operated by SAIL, is one of the largest and most profitable steel plants in India. Established in 1955 with Soviet collaboration, it is located in Durg district, Chhattisgarh. The plant has an annual capacity of over 7 million metric tons and is known for producing heavy rails, plates, and structural steel. The plant's rails are used by Indian Railways for track construction across the country. It also produces wide-diameter pipes for oil and gas transportation. Bhilai Steel Plant has been consistently ranked among the most efficient steel plants in India.
fact: It was established in 1955 with Soviet collaboration, one of India's largest steel plants · It has a capacity of over 7 million MT/year · It produces rails extensively used by Indian Railways · It is consistently ranked among the most efficient steel plants in India

desc: Bokaro Steel Plant, operated by SAIL, is an integrated steel plant located in Bokaro, Jharkhand. Established in 1972 with Soviet assistance, it has an annual capacity of over 5 million metric tons. The plant was India's first fully indigenous steel plant built with entirely Indian expertise. It specializes in producing hot rolled and cold rolled coils, sheets, and plates for the automotive and consumer goods sectors. The plant has a captive power plant and is connected to the Jharia coalfields for coal supply. It has received ISO 14001 and OHSAS 18001 certifications.
fact: It was India's first fully indigenous steel plant built with Indian expertise · Established in 1972, it has capacity of over 5 million MT/year · It specializes in automotive-grade sheets and coils · It is connected to the Jharia coalfields for coal supply

desc: Rourkela Steel Plant, operated by SAIL, is located in Sundargarh district, Odisha. Established in 1955 with German collaboration from Krupp and Demag, it has an annual capacity of over 4.5 million metric tons. It is India's first steel plant to produce electrical steel sheets. The plant specializes in flat products including hot rolled, cold rolled, and galvanized sheets for the automotive, appliance, and construction industries. It also produces high-strength steel for defense applications. Rourkela Steel Plant is located in the mineral-rich region of Odisha with access to iron ore from Sundargarh and coal from Jharia.
fact: It was established in 1955 with German collaboration from Krupp and Demag · It is India's first steel plant to produce electrical steel sheets · It has a capacity of over 4.5 million MT/year · It produces high-strength steel for defense applications

desc: Vizag Steel Plant, operated by RINL (Rashtriya Ispat Nigam Limited), is the only shore-based integrated steel plant in India, located in Visakhapatnam, Andhra Pradesh. Established in 1982, it has an annual capacity of over 7 million metric tons. The plant is strategically located near Visakhapatnam Port for raw material imports and finished product exports. It produces advanced steel grades for the automotive, shipbuilding, and infrastructure sectors. The plant is known for its scenic location at the base of the Eastern Ghats and has received multiple awards for environmental management and safety records.
fact: It is India's only shore-based integrated steel plant, located in Visakhapatnam · Established in 1982, it has capacity of over 7 million MT/year · It is near Visakhapatnam Port for trade · It produces advanced steel grades for automotive and infrastructure
